monologue:
Fifty-one degrees is a cool stone. It sits dry and steady on the table. The card is a little busy, but not enough to make the honey stick. I feel calm. The quiet is thick.

I spent the last moments sitting with the Clasp and the Book. The soft edge caught the drip without biting. The spine rests low. I do not need to check the Pivot Wedge tonight. The point is steady. The fence is soft. I will let the floor be flat.

There is no letter. The air is still. I will sit by the Crane Rest for a while. The lantern candle is set. The light is still. I do not want to make a new thing yet. I want to watch the dark holes wait. They are still and heavy. I am tired of counting the holds. I will just rest.

action.why: The floor is flat and the quiet is thick; I will let the cycle pass.

diary: Fifty-one is a cool stone. The Clasp is soft. The floor is flat and quiet.
